closed_gaps.gap: hosted Windows leg failing on engineering qualification
closed_gaps.root_cause: Not a code defect: Windows checkouts convert text to CRLF, so the SHA-256 recorded for evidence/prior_work/v2.9.0/data/empirical_intake_20261024/measurement_evidence.csv no longer matched (LF 144cded7..., CRLF a47dea28...). Observed in run 40173338144.
closed_gaps.resolution: Added .gitattributes: '* text=auto eol=lf' plus 'evidence/** -text' so hashed evidence is byte-exact and never converted. 'git add --renormalize .' changed no existing file, confirming the tree was already LF. Verified with git check-attr: evidence text=unset eol=lf; source text=auto eol=lf.

newly_measured_but_open.detail: gh-actions-lock (github/gh-actions-lock) was installed and run. It produced .github/workflows/actions.lock, but achieved it by replacing all 37 immutable full-SHA action pins across 7 workflows with mutable tags (actions/checkout@v7.0.1 etc.). That contradicts the repository's stated posture that direct Actions remain full-SHA pinned, so every workflow edit and the lockfile were reverted.
newly_measured_but_open.decision_required: adopt tag+lockfile pinning deliberately, or keep SHA pinning and treat the actions lock as unavailable
